title: Vonage Video App Config
description: Unified application-config schema consolidated across the Android, iOS and React (web) Vonage Video apps. Fields common to all platforms are required; platform-specific toggles are optional. The 'x-envVar' annotation records the flat environment-variable name used by the React app (frontend/vite.config.ts) for each flag; Android and iOS consume the nested JSON keys directly. Extra boolean feature flags are allowed forward-compatibly within the settings objects.

metadata.description: Document metadata: name, version, creation date and description.

baseApiUrl.description: Base URL for the app API. May be a literal URL or a ${VAR} build-time placeholder. Android reads it from BASE_API_URL; React from API_URL.

fallbackLanguage.description: BCP-47 language tag used when no supported language matches.

supportedLanguages.description: List of BCP-47 language tags the app offers. In the React .env this is a comma-separated string.

appSettings.description: App-level feature toggles. React only; optional.

enableReportIssue.description: When true, shows the 'report an issue' control so users can submit problem reports.

showVideoStats.description: When true, exposes the video statistics overlay (bitrate, resolution, packet loss) during a call.

connectionSettings.description: Networking/host overrides. React only; optional. Values may be literal or ${VAR} placeholders.

tunnelDomain.description: Public tunnel domain used to expose the local dev server; added to the dev server's allowed hosts list.

vonageVideoHost.description: Override for the Vonage Video API host the client connects to.

videoSettings.description: Camera and video feature toggles and defaults.

allowBackgroundEffects.description: When true, users can apply background blur or replacement to their camera feed.

allowCameraControl.description: When true, users can toggle their camera on and off during a call.

allowVideoOnJoin.description: When true, the camera is enabled automatically when the user joins.

defaultResolution.description: Default camera capture resolution as WIDTHxHEIGHT in pixels.

audioSettings.description: Microphone and audio feature toggles. allowAudioDiagnostics is iOS only.

allowAdvancedNoiseSuppression.description: When true, users can enable advanced background noise suppression.

allowAudioOnJoin.description: When true, the microphone is enabled automatically when the user joins.

allowMicrophoneControl.description: When true, users can toggle their microphone on and off during a call.

allowAudioDiagnostics.description: When true, users can run audio diagnostics to test microphone and speaker (iOS only).

waitingRoomSettings.description: Waiting-room feature toggles. allowSettings is iOS + React; bypassWaitingRoom is React only.

allowDeviceSelection.description: When true, users can choose camera/microphone/speaker devices in the waiting room.

allowSettings.description: When true, the advanced settings panel is available in the waiting room (iOS and React).

bypassWaitingRoom.description: When true, users skip the waiting room and join the meeting directly (React only).

meetingRoomSettings.description: In-meeting feature toggles and defaults. allowFeedback and allowPictureInPicture are iOS only.

allowSettings.description: When true, the advanced settings panel is available inside the meeting room.

allowArchiving.description: When true, users can start and stop recording (archiving) of the meeting.

allowCaptions.description: When true, live captions can be enabled during the meeting.

allowChat.description: When true, the in-meeting text chat is available.

allowDeviceSelection.description: When true, users can change camera/microphone/speaker devices during the meeting.

allowEmojis.description: When true, users can send emoji reactions during the meeting.

allowFeedback.description: When true, a post-call feedback prompt is shown (iOS only).

allowPictureInPicture.description: When true, the meeting can continue in a picture-in-picture window (iOS only).

allowScreenShare.description: When true, users can share their screen during the meeting.

defaultLayoutMode.description: Default video layout used when entering the meeting room.

showParticipantList.description: When true, the participant list panel is available during the meeting.

metadata.description: Document metadata describing this config file.

name.description: Human-readable name of this config document.

version.description: Semantic version of this config document, matching the schema version it targets.

created.description: Date this config document was created (ISO 8601, YYYY-MM-DD).

description.description: Human-readable description of this config document.

semver.description: Semantic version (MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH) of the config document, matching the schema version it targets.

resolution.description: Video resolution as WIDTHxHEIGHT in pixels.

layoutMode.description: Default video layout in the meeting room.
